adjudication_label: batch_26:Morphology and microstructure evolution during processing
canonical_question: Why does the text state homogenization is 'achieved' at 30 and 40 h if no significant morphological variations are shown?

question_variants.question: Will the 'microstructure' observed in the bulk sintered samples be representative of the powder microstructure prior to sintering?
question_variants.resolution_summary: The paper states that milling time affects final materials and notes powder morphology changes, but does not explicitly state whether the final bulk microstructure is representative of the pre-sintering powder microstructure.
source_evidence_spans: The variation in the milling time on the powders may greatly affect the final materials

question_variants.question: Why does the text state homogenization is 'achieved' at 30 and 40 h if no significant morphological variations are shown?
question_variants.resolution_summary: The text states homogenization is achieved at 30 and 40 h, but does not explain why this term is used when no significant morphological variations are explicitly shown in the provided text for those specific time points versus others.
source_evidence_spans: homogenization of the fully mechanically alloyed powders is achieved
